summary: Validated iteration 30 — graceful error handling for /api/weather/severe/grid/bulk when Open-Meteo upstream is unavailable. Backend correctly returns HTTP 503 with short friendly French messages (no Open-Meteo URL leakage). Disk path fallback chain (_resolve_bulk_file) works: STORM_CACHE_DIR env override respected, falls back to /tmp when primary cache dir is read-only, _save_bulk_to_disk swallows PermissionError. Frontend FranceMapPanel displays the loading spinner with explanatory text, shows the friendly error banner on failure, the Réessayer button correctly re-triggers the fetch via retryToken state, and the rest of the page (tabs, header, charts) remains fully navigable — no white screen, no ErrorBoundary crash.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L519-545: error mapping order (429 → timeout → connect) is correct; messages are short (≤80 chars) and never contain Open-Meteo URL. ✓
severe.py _resolve_bulk_file: write-probe at each candidate ensures only writable paths are returned; STORM_CACHE_DIR is inserted at index 0 (highest priority) — verified by test. ✓
severe.py _save_bulk_to_disk: catches PermissionError AND OSError separately with informative log + continues with in-memory snapshot — read-only FS won't crash requests. ✓
api.js getSevereGridBulk: timeout: 90000 — appropriate for cold-start on weak Atom CPU. ✓
FranceMapPanel.jsx L290-351: useEffect deps include [retryToken], so setRetryToken(t+1) cleanly re-runs the fetch; setError(null) before the fetch clears the banner immediately on retry click. ✓
FranceMapPanel.jsx L336-348: detail string is truncated to 200 chars before display — banner can never overflow the map. ✓

Live observation: backend currently returns 503 with detail='Rate-limit Open-Meteo atteint — réessaie dans 30-60 s.' (sandbox IP is rate-limited as expected per agent context); frontend renders 'Run météo indisponible : Rate-limit Open-Meteo atteint — réessaie dans 30-60 s.' — perfectly matches the intended UX.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 error-handling scenarios validated: (a) backend 503 friendly mapping (429/timeout/connect) via mocked get_with_retry, (b) disk fallback chain via fixture with read-only dirs, (c) STORM_CACHE_DIR env override, (d) frontend retry-token loop. Live endpoint currently returns 503 because the sandbox IP is rate-limited by Open-Meteo (as expected per agent_to_agent_context_note). Once the rate-limit clears, the same test will additionally validate the 200 success path (test_bulk_endpoint_reachable already handles both branches). Test file uses asyncio.run() instead of pytest-asyncio (the plugin is not installed in this env), works cleanly on pytest 9.0.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration 29 returned a degraded payload (200 OK with no per_param) on upstream failure, which caused the frontend to display the generic 'Snapshot bulk invalide' fallback message. Fix in iteration 30 routes ALL upstream failures through a proper HTTP 503 with mapped friendly messages (429 → rate-limit, Timeout → délai, ConnectError → connexion) and the frontend distinguishes statuses + truncates oversized details + offers a one-click retry via state token. Disk-path PermissionError on read-only FS (Kimsufi www-data) is also handled gracefully by _save_bulk_to_disk catching PermissionError/OSError and the resolver trying STORM_CACHE_DIR → package cache → /tmp in order.
